# Index of Concepts {.unnumbered}

Online search can find every occurrence of a word. This index serves a different purpose: it identifies the chapter where a concept receives its main explanation and selected later chapters where the concept is extended, tested, or applied. It is therefore a map of the book's cumulative argument, not a list of every passing mention. Major teaching cases and demonstrations are indexed separately in [Appendix B](appendices/appendix-b-index-of-major-course-examples.qmd).
